configurations.//: Attach-only (url, no command): connects to the `composer dev` server already on :8000 instead of racing it for the port. The port is NOT interchangeable, so autoPort must stay off — APP_URL is pinned to http://localhost:8000 and every asset('storage/...') URL the player loads is absolute against it, so a reassigned port would break lesson media and session cookies.
configurations.name: serve

configurations.//: The globe lighting measurement harness (resources/js/timemap/__harness__). Standalone Vite, nothing to do with the Laravel app — it serves one page plus public/, where the relief map and cloud fields live. On 5198 rather than 5199: the tile-pyramid harness below claimed 5199 first, and two harnesses on one port is a race that presents as a blank page.
configurations.name: globe-harness

configurations.//: Development only, for measuring the tile pyramid — see resources/js/timemap/tiles/__harness__. A bare Vite dev server on its own port, so it never races the app's :5173 that other sessions are using.
configurations.name: tiled-lod-harness

configurations.//: Standalone globe-layer harness: esbuild bundle plus the baked ocean fields, no Laravel involved. Exists because the ocean layer cannot be judged from a screenshot — it is measured with gl.readPixels from inside a render pass. Port 5183 keeps it clear of the two Vite harnesses above.
configurations.name: ocean-harness
